name: @claimguard/cli
description: Command-line demo of the claim validation engine: give it an NDIA-format bulk CSV, a plan and a catalogue, get per-line verdicts with plain-English reasons. The honest seed of the product — no database, no network, just the engine.

scripts.demo: tsx src/main.ts validate ../../seed/FIXTURE_demo/FIXTURE_claims.csv --plan ../../seed/FIXTURE_golden-set/FIXTURE_plan.json --catalogue ../../seed/FIXTURE_golden-set/FIXTURE_catalogue.json --config ../../seed/FIXTURE_golden-set/FIXTURE_config.json --date 2026-08-27 || echo "(La demo termina con codigo 1 a proposito: el archivo de ejemplo contiene reclamos que fallan.)"
